name: Stability AI
label: Stability AI
description: Official Stability REST v2beta Stable Image (generate / upscale / edit / control) at https://api.stability.ai. Handler: OfficialApiNode. Auth is StudioQuack secret api_key as Authorization Bearer. Image payloads use type file (platform ref-id). Docs: https://platform.stability.ai/docs/api-reference/. Terms: https://stability.ai/terms-of-service. Never log api_key. Prompt and images leave the host.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. generate requires prompt. upscale/control require image (type file) + prompt. edit requires image (type file). get_result requires id from an async job. Do not put api_key here. Example: {"prompt":"lighthouse on a cliff","aspect_ratio":"1:1"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official call to run. EXACT: generate | upscale | edit | control | get_result. get_result needs id only (no prompt). Blank uses config operation or infers get_result when only id is set.

schema.label: prompt
schema.description: Text prompt. generate/upscale/control: required (1–10000 chars). edit: required for inpaint/search-and-replace; omit for remove-background.

schema.label: image
schema.description: Platform file ref-id for upscale/edit/control (and optional image-to-image generate). jpeg/png/webp. Never inline bytes.

schema.label: mask
schema.description: Platform file ref-id mask for inpaint/erase. White = edit region. Never inline bytes.

schema.label: id
schema.description: Generation id for get_result (GET /v2beta/results/{id}). HTTP 202 = still running.

schema.label: aspect_ratio
schema.description: Request-body parameter `aspect_ratio` for operation: generate.

schema.label: negative_prompt
schema.description: Request-body parameter `negative_prompt` for operations: generate, upscale, edit, control.

schema.label: seed
schema.description: Seed integer for generate / upscale / edit / control. 0 = random.

schema.label: style_preset
schema.description: Request-body parameter `style_preset` for operation: generate.

schema.label: output_format
schema.description: Request-body parameter `output_format` for operations: generate, upscale, edit, control.

schema.label: creativity
schema.description: upscale creativity 0.1–0.5 (conservative–creative).

schema.label: search_prompt
schema.description: Request-body parameter `search_prompt` for operation: edit.

schema.label: select_prompt
schema.description: What to recolor for edit_mode search-and-recolor. Example: the red car.

schema.label: left
schema.description: edit outpaint pixels left.

schema.label: right
schema.description: edit outpaint pixels right.

schema.label: up
schema.description: edit outpaint pixels up.

schema.label: down
schema.description: edit outpaint pixels down.

schema.label: control_strength
schema.description: control control_strength 0–1.

schema.label: style_strength
schema.description: control style_strength 0–1 for style-transfer mode.

schema.label: style_image
schema.description: Reference style image (type file) for control_mode style-transfer.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (provider JSON or binary metadata). HTTP 202 on get_result means in progress. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Exact 'ok' on HTTP 2xx (including 202 in-progress for get_result).

schema.label: HTTP status
schema.description: Upstream status code.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Provider JSON when Accept is application/json; otherwise opaque body. Prefer JSON so OfficialApiNode can parse.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official Stable Image verb. EXACT: generate | upscale | edit | control | get_result. Default generate = POST /v2beta/stable-image/generate/{engine}.

configurationParameters.label: API Key
configurationParameters.description: Stability platform API key. Sent as Authorization: Bearer. StudioQuack secret binding only. Never logged. Empty → error 'api_key is required'.

configurationParameters.label: Generate engine
configurationParameters.description: Path {engine} for operation=generate. EXACT: core | ultra | sd3. Default core (Stable Image Core). Verify live list on platform.stability.ai.

configurationParameters.label: Upscale mode
configurationParameters.description: Path {upscale_mode} for operation=upscale. EXACT: conservative | creative | fast. creative is async — poll get_result with the returned id.

configurationParameters.label: Edit mode
configurationParameters.description: Path {edit_mode} for operation=edit. EXACT: inpaint | outpaint | erase | search-and-replace | search-and-recolor | remove-background | replace-background-and-relight.

configurationParameters.label: Select Prompt
configurationParameters.description: What to recolor for edit search-and-recolor. Example: the red car.

configurationParameters.label: Control mode
configurationParameters.description: Path {control_mode} for operation=control. EXACT: sketch | structure | style | style-transfer.

configurationParameters.label: Style Image
configurationParameters.description: Reference style image for control style-transfer (platform file ref-id).

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: HTTP timeout. Default 120. Floor 1. Creative upscale/edit can exceed 60s — use get_result instead of raising this unbounded.
